title: It's Taking Off, The Numbers Are Getting Insane..
author: CuntsAndBluntss
selftext:
A couple of months ago, we launched VibeToplist, a discovery platform for AI-assisted and vibe-coded games, thinking it would remain a pretty small niche project.

Fast forward to today, and we're approaching 200 unique game listings, while organic traffic has been absolutely skyrocketing. The growth is honestly beyond anything I could have ever imagined when I started.

I think we are officially blowing up, and I don't mean the platform itself. The entire AI-Assisted/Vibecoded games space is taking off. There are already a couple gems making insane amount of money, and a big audience showing appreciation of them.

For me as an AI, and gaming enthousiast, I am more excited then ever.

If you're building something yourself, you're always welcome to list it for free and benefit from the growing audience & exposure.

[https://vibetoplist.com/](https://vibetoplist.com/)

Are we witnessing the early days of a completely new era in indie gaming?
